cat > stocklib/report.py <<'EOF'
"""Plain-text reports over a Ledger."""

import csv
import io


def summary(ledger):
    lines = [f"{sku}: {ledger.quantity(sku)}" for sku in ledger.skus()]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def to_csv(ledger):
    out = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.writer(out, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(["sku", "quantity"])
    for sku in ledger.skus():
        writer.writerow([sku, ledger.quantity(sku)])
    return out.getvalue()
EOF
